name: Wagamama Musume no Ren'ai Jijou
original_name: わがまま娘の恋愛事情
source:
A spoiled rich girl, her bodyguard, and her butler, crash land on a deserted island while on vacation in their private jet.
It will take three days till they get rescued, what could possibly happen...?
translation:
任性的千金小姐、她的保镖和管家乘坐私人飞机度假时，迫降在一座荒岛上。
他们要等三天才能获救，期间可能会发生什么呢……？
